33. The objectors in this case as rightly pointed out by the trial Court failed to establish any right, title or interest over the decreetal property.
They themselves claim that the property acquired by Munimallappa and their father were different.
Indirectly they claim that the decree holder has tried to execute the decree against their property.
Therefore, obstructors are not entitled to obstruct execution of the decree.
The objectors' application was dismissed second time in the year 2006 itself.
Moreover whatever is produced is only xerox copy.
